final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, COUNT(*) AS total_accounts FROM order_counts) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(1.0 * order_count / total_orders) AS average_share, AVG(1.0 * order_count / total_orders - 1.0 / total_accounts) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM order_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE 1.0 * order_count / total_orders > 1.0 / total_accounts
